gate_baseline_uri_note: PER-SCHEDULE BY DECISION, and this SUPERSEDES the W1.0 seed. The rolling-census machinery is per-SCHEDULE (advance_rolling_census advances one baseline per fire, and a shared baseline would make each schedule's --diff read the other schedule's rows as unexplained drift), so silver_futures_eod carries one baseline per schedule: futures_eod_databento (this one) and futures_eod_free (W1a, four free venues). The family-level seed named in plan D6 and in jobs/audit/advance_rolling_census.py -- s3://leviathan-dev-shahem-001/cascade_census/rolling/futures_eod/census.json -- is SUPERSEDED and MUST NOT be consulted, minted or advanced; a diff against it would compare this schedule's rows to the union of both. futures_eod_gate.py gate 8 emits one silver_rebuild_gate command per schedule against its own baseline, deliberately.
notes: CRON 08:00 UTC TUE-SAT, deliberately NOT the yfinance chain's 23:00. F3: the ohlcv-1d close is the session's last trade, the real settlement rides the GLBX statistics schema, and venues publish preliminary settlements first with FINAL settlements often only on the NEXT calendar day. A 23:00 UTC fire sits inside the CME settlement publication window and would ingest preliminary values; 08:00 UTC is ~02:00-03:00 CT the morning AFTER each session, which clears the GLBX statistics publication window, the ICE EOD, and the vendor's own batch pipeline. TUE-SAT because the run covers the PRIOR business day (a Monday session is published in the Tuesday fire; a Friday session in the Saturday fire). WAVE 3 + retrofit_landed: this is a NEW class-A registered-partition chain, so it is not part of the frozen wave-2 CLASS-B retrofit set. FAMILY is futures_eod, never futures -- dag_catalog maps silver_futures_eod to its own family and the silver_futures prefix would swallow the live yfinance table. Incremental windows are passed as --lookback-days rather than a templated date because the scheduler substitutes only <aws.scheduler.*> context attributes; 5 days matches the registry freshness_sla max_lag_days and costs ~$0.08 at the measured $0.016/day. NO bronze phase: the Databento leg is raw(DBN)->silver in one task via transforms.raw_to_bronze.databento_eod + transforms.bronze_to_silver.databento_eod. PROMOTE_MODE IS stop_and_notify, NOT autonomous, AND THAT IS DELIBERATE. F2 states that no registered-contract surface may consume ICE bars until a (trade_date, raw_symbol) uniqueness assertion passes ON PURCHASED DATA, and ICE_BAR_RULE is still the PROVISIONAL keep_last_by_ts_event pending probe P3 (the competing publisher-split hypothesis: IFEU 57/84, IFUS 97/98). stop_and_notify renders promote.tasks EMPTY, so the machine publishes SHADOW only and a human promotes after P3 and the eight gates. Flip to autonomous in the same commit that pins ICE_BAR_RULE against real data. The producer additionally asserts natural-key AND (trade_date, raw_symbol) uniqueness in-process before staging, and an incremental run UNIONS with the existing canonical partitions before publishing (it holds five days but stages the whole trade_year object). BEFORE ARMING: (a) mint the gate_baseline_uri census (it does not exist yet), (b) register the two jobdefs in terraform, (c) provision the leviathan/dev/databento-api-key secret + the execution-role GetSecretValue grant, (d) rebuild + repin the worker image with the pyproject [batch] databento pin.
